punchline: Santiago's dream stopped one step short of the answer, twice, and he sold his sheep anyway.
thirty_sec: A shepherd sleeps in a ruined church under a sycamore and dreams a child leads him to the Egyptian pyramids, where a treasure waits. He wakes before the spot is shown. The dream comes again, the same way. A gypsy woman tells him to go, and an old king talks about a Personal Legend. Santiago sells his flock and crosses to Africa, and on his first day in Tangier he is robbed of everything.
